summaries.summary: Explosions have been reported on Iran’s Qeshm Island following U.S. strikes related to tensions in the Strait of Hormuz amid U.S. midterm elections.
Apple's uncertainty over the availability of its new foldable iPhone Duo continues as production constraints persist.
Google has expanded its AI project, Dreambeans, to India, supporting 13 languages and aimed at creating personal AI-generated stories.
Tech companies have dismantled a botnet consisting of 1.3 million TV boxes that were being used as proxies.
Apple is exploring ways to increase revenue through third-party AI applications.
A Kyiv startup has developed a device to exploit and intercept video feeds from Russian drones.
Delhi police are protesting against officer transfers, leading to disciplinary actions for participating in these demonstrations.
The Supreme Court of India has permitted the use of green crackers for Diwali celebrations in 2026, allowing for a limited use on specified dates.
India's economy continues to grow despite geopolitical tensions, with plans for significant renewable energy expansions over the next decade.
Google has added a new easter egg related to the game 'Zelda: Ocarina of Time' in its search engine.
